content.text:
**Connected Tools**

In Mistral’s Work chat, use **Connected Tools** to fetch live data from connected services like Gmail, Drive, or Notion.

It differs from Web Search because Connected Tools provide **authenticated access to your connected service accounts** (enabling direct reads/writes to your personal or workspace data), while Web Search performs **general queries on the public internet** and returns only publicly available information.

[Connected Tools](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/work-chat#connected-tools)
[Web Search](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/work-chat#web-search)
